title: Add a quick toggle for Bluetooth discoverability in the widget
line: The Bluetooth widget's menu now has a "Visible to nearby devices" checkbox, so you can receive files from an unpaired phone without opening System Settings.
explanation: The Bluetooth widget only offered the on/off switch, so making the computer discoverable (needed for an unpaired phone to find it and send a file) meant opening System Settings and its "Visible" switch. The change adds a checkable "Visible to nearby devices" action that reads and sets the adapter's Discoverable property; it appears in the widget's hamburger menu (system tray and standalone) and in the right-click menu, only while Bluetooth is on.

commits.message:
applet: add a toggle to make the computer visible to nearby devices

Receiving files from a device that was never paired needs the computer to
be discoverable, which could only be turned on from System Settings. Add a
checkable "Visible to nearby devices" action to the widget's menu.

BUG: 495321

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 19:15:56 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: add a toggle to make the computer visible to nearby
 devices

Receiving files from a device that was never paired needs the computer to
be discoverable, which could only be turned on from System Settings. Add a
checkable "Visible to nearby devices" action to the widget's menu.

BUG: 495321

--- a/src/applet/qml/FullRepresentation.qml

@@ -27,6 +27,7 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
     required property PlasmoidItem plasmoidItem

+    required property PlasmaCore.Action toggleDiscoverableAction
     required property PlasmaCore.Action toggleBadgeAction
     required property PlasmaCore.Action configureAction
 
@@ -89,6 +90,7 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
         plasmoidItem: root.plasmoidItem

         toggleBluetoothAction: root.toggleBluetoothAction

diff --git a/src/applet/qml/Toolbar.qml b/src/applet/qml/Toolbar.qml

     required property PlasmaCore.Action toggleBadgeAction

@@ -83,6 +84,11 @@ PlasmaExtras.PlasmoidHeading {
                 visualParent: moreActionsButton
                 placement: PlasmaExtras.Menu.BottomPosedLeftAlignedPopup
 
+                PlasmaExtras.MenuItem {

diff --git a/src/applet/qml/main.qml b/src/applet/qml/main.qml

--- a/src/applet/qml/main.qml
+++ b/src/applet/qml/main.qml
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     readonly property alias addDeviceAction: addDeviceAction
     readonly property alias toggleBluetoothAction: toggleBluetoothAction
+    readonly property alias toggleDiscoverableAction: toggleDiscoverableAction
     readonly property alias toggleBadgeAction: toggleBadgeAction
     readonly property alias configureAction: configureAction
 
@@ -32,6 +33,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         plasmoidItem: root
         addDeviceAction: root.addDeviceAction
         toggleBluetoothAction: root.toggleBluetoothAction
+        toggleDiscoverableAction: root.toggleDiscoverableAction
         toggleBadgeAction: root.toggleBadgeAction
         configureAction: root.configureAction
     }
@@ -125,6 +127,18 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             visible: !BluezQt.Manager.bluetoothBlocked
             onTriggered: checked => PlasmaBt.LaunchApp.launchWizard()
         },
+        PlasmaCore.Action {
+            id: toggleDiscoverableAction
+            text: i18nc("@option:check", "Visible to nearby devices")
+            icon.name: "view-visible-symbolic"
+            alwaysShowAsMenu: true
+            checkable: true
+            checked: BluezQt.Manager.usableAdapter?.discoverable ?? false

+                BluezQt.Manager.usableAdapter.discoverable = checked;
+            }

media.caption: Widget menu on master: only the badge option, no way to become visible
New "Visible to nearby devices" checkbox, turned on

reviews.text: Adding a checkable "Visible to nearby devices" PlasmaCore.Action with alwaysShowAsMenu: true cleanly addresses the wishlist request in both the widget's hamburger menu (system tray and standalone) and the right-click context menu without cluttering the header. It follows the existing toggleBadgeAction/toggleBluetoothAction pattern, binds to BluezQt.Manager.usableAdapter?.discoverable so external changes and BlueZ timeouts stay in sync, and hides cleanly when Bluetooth is not operational.
